records.source_evidence: User screenshot e1f924c0-c45e-4f65-af4a-04235484ba0d, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Susan
records.source: [NPC] Susan: Good heavens, that's great news!
records.translation: [NPC] Susan: Вот это да! Отличная новость!
records.source_evidence: User screenshot e1f924c0-c45e-4f65-af4a-04235484ba0d, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Susan
records.source: [NPC] Susan: With dangerous activity running rampant recently, we could really use your help.
records.translation: [NPC] Susan: В последнее время вокруг всё больше опасностей. Нам очень нужна ваша помощь.
records.source_evidence: User screenshot e1f924c0-c45e-4f65-af4a-04235484ba0d, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Kat
records.source: [NPC] Kat: Stop by once it's done, okay?
records.translation: [NPC] Kat: Приходите, когда улучшение будет готово, хорошо?
records.source_evidence: User screenshot e1f924c0-c45e-4f65-af4a-04235484ba0d, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Susan
records.source: [NPC] Susan: You'll need to undergo some training to become a Safety Advocate.
records.translation: [NPC] Susan: Чтобы стать представителем отряда безопасности, вам нужно пройти обучение.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Susan
records.source: [NPC] Susan: Is this fine with you? I promise it won't take long.
records.translation: [NPC] Susan: Вы согласны? Обещаю, это не займёт много времени.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Susan
records.source: [NPC] Susan: Processing your registration...
records.translation: [NPC] Susan: Оформляю вашу регистрацию...
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Susan
records.source: [NPC] Susan: Head into the doorway next to me, she'll be waiting for you!
records.translation: [NPC] Susan: Пройдите в дверь рядом со мной: она уже вас ждёт!
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Susan
records.source: [NPC] Susan: Brigette is waiting for you in the Security Hall. Better not keep her waiting!
records.translation: [NPC] Susan: Brigette ждёт вас в Зале охраны. Лучше не заставлять её ждать!
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Hey, recruit!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Привет, новобранец!
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Come this way.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Идите сюда.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Here, take a seat.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Вот, присаживайтесь.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Welcome to the Security Hall. It's the place for all safety matters.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Добро пожаловать в Зал охраны! Здесь мы занимаемся вопросами безопасности.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: I believe Elizabeth has already introduced you to what we do.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Полагаю, Элизабет уже рассказала вам, чем мы занимаемся.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: The goal of the Safety Squad is to keep SkyBlock safe, and it starts with you.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Отряд безопасности защищает SkyBlock, и всё начинается с вас.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Yes, you!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Да, с вас!
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: If everyone is aware of the importance of safety, the number of safety-related incidents would greatly decrease.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Если каждый будет понимать важность безопасности, происшествий станет гораздо меньше.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: I'm glad you asked.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Рада, что вы спросили.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: On one hand, it is very important to do things to keep yourself as safe as possible.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Прежде всего, очень важно принимать меры для собственной безопасности.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Stay indoors when there's a thunderstorm, wear a safety hat while at a construction site, washing your hands frequently while in a hospital...
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Во время грозы оставайтесь в помещении, на стройке носите каску, а в больнице чаще мойте руки...
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: These are all examples of physical safety.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Всё это примеры физической безопасности.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Today, however, we will be focused on something that's also very important.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Но сегодня мы поговорим о другом — о том, что тоже очень важно.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: That being - Account Safety.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: А именно — о безопасности аккаунта.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Imagine logging in to SkyBlock and finding that all your belongings have disappeared.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Представьте: вы заходите в SkyBlock, а все ваши вещи исчезли.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Or even worse, trying to log into your Minecraft account but finding yourself locked out.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Или ещё хуже: пытаетесь войти в свой аккаунт Minecraft, но больше не можете получить к нему доступ.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: The point of Account Safety is to prevent this from happening.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Безопасность аккаунта нужна, чтобы такого не случилось.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: And that's why you should pay close attention to today's briefing.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Поэтому внимательно послушайте сегодняшний инструктаж.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: SkyBlock has a lot of players.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: В SkyBlock очень много игроков.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: You will meet a lot of them throughout playing SkyBlock.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Во время игры в SkyBlock вы познакомитесь со многими из них.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: You could even make some very good friends!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: И даже сможете найти хороших друзей!
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: However, not everyone is here to make friends.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Но не все приходят сюда ради дружбы.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Some of them are here to steal your coins, items, or even your account!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Некоторые хотят украсть ваши монеты, вещи или даже сам аккаунт!
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Of course it doesn't.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Конечно, ничего хорошего.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Rule number 1, never trust strangers on the internet.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Правило номер 1: никогда не доверяйте незнакомцам в интернете.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Strangers are people you just met. You don't know who they are.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Незнакомцы — это люди, которых вы только что встретили. Вы не знаете, кто они на самом деле.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: If someone approaches you, they very likely want something from you.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Если кто-то сам к вам обращается, скорее всего, ему что-то от вас нужно.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: What looks like a seemingly innocent request could lead to you losing your account.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Даже безобидная на вид просьба может привести к тому, что вы потеряете аккаунт.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: The most common way to lose your account is by opening suspicious links.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Чаще всего аккаунт теряют, переходя по подозрительным ссылкам.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: If someone sends a link in chat, chances are they are trying to steal your account.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Если кто-то присылает ссылку в чат, возможно, он пытается украсть ваш аккаунт.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: I'm sure you're not!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Уверена, вы не настолько глупы!
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: The thing is, the evil people who steal accounts will try to catch you off guard.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Дело в том, что похитители аккаунтов стараются застать вас врасплох.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: They try to make you open links in situations where it seems reasonable.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Они предлагают перейти по ссылке в ситуации, когда это кажется вполне разумным.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Or situations where you're distracted, or least suspecting a scam.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Или когда вы отвлеклись и совсем не ожидаете обмана.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: A way hackers can gain your trust is by messaging you from an account they've already hacked.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Чтобы завоевать ваше доверие, злоумышленники могут написать вам с уже взломанного аккаунта.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: If it looks like your friend sent you that message, you'd be inclined to trust them more, right?
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Если кажется, что сообщение прислал ваш друг, вы ведь скорее ему поверите?
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Then when you click the link they send you...
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: А потом вы переходите по присланной ссылке...
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Just like that, your account is gone.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: И вот так теряете свой аккаунт.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Scary I am indeed.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Да, умею напугать.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: But losing your account is an even scarier proposition.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Но потерять аккаунт куда страшнее.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Anyways.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Ладно, продолжим.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: We were talking about links, and how you should be very careful when clicking on links.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Мы говорили о ссылках и о том, как важно быть осторожными, переходя по ним.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: If you ever receive a suspicious message in-game, you should report the player with the /report command.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Если получите в игре подозрительное сообщение, пожалуйтесь на отправителя командой /report.
records.source_evidence: User screenshots and local NPC-only latest.log extract, 2026-10-13, through04:51:22

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: The dangers of clicking unverified links is not limited to within SkyBlock.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Опасность перехода по непроверенным ссылкам существует не только в SkyBlock.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: It's something that applies all over the internet, really.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Это касается всего интернета.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: There are some situations where you may encounter suspicious links for SkyBlock outside of the game itself.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Подозрительные ссылки, связанные со SkyBlock, могут встретиться и за пределами самой игры.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: For example, you may be trying to download a mod for SkyBlock.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Например, когда вы пытаетесь скачать мод для SkyBlock.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Or perhaps, you're linked a page to someone's SkyBlock profile, to check out their stats or something.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Или вам присылают ссылку на чей-то профиль SkyBlock, чтобы вы посмотрели характеристики.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: While it's unlikely that these links are bad, you should be careful when clicking them, and try your best to verify whether they're trustworthy.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Хотя такие ссылки обычно не опасны, переходите по ним осторожно и старайтесь проверить, можно ли им доверять.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: That's the spirit!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Вот это правильный настрой!
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: You're saying we got another recruit? That's great, I'll get them settled.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Говоришь, у нас ещё один новобранец? Отлично, сейчас помогу ему устроиться.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Thanks, Salad!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Спасибо, Салат!
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13; joke clarified from screenshots c52a92b9 and612fff4b,2026-10-15

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Well that's not good!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Вот это уже нехорошо!
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: I hope you both are okay.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Надеюсь, вы оба в порядке.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: New recruit, you may use my chair for now.
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Новобранец, пока можете занять мой стул.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Brigette
records.source: [NPC] Brigette: Be right back!
records.translation: [NPC] Brigette: Сейчас вернусь!
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: Hi, the name's Jimmy.
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Привет, меня зовут Jimmy.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: This place looks awesome. I'm all about security.
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Здесь здорово! Я всегда за безопасность.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: I got these really cool gauntlets. It lets me fight against baddies.
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: У меня есть отличные боевые перчатки. С ними я могу драться с негодяями.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: You don't look quite ready for a security job. Where's your gear, bro?
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Ты не слишком готов к работе в охране. Где твоё снаряжение, дружище?
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: Say, would you like to trade for my gauntlets?
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Слушай, хочешь купить мои боевые перчатки?
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: It will allow you to punch well above your weight.
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: С ними ты сможешь драться с противниками куда сильнее себя.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: For the lowly price of 999 coins, they can be yours.
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Они могут стать твоими всего за 999 монет.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: If you're down for it, we can trade outside the Security Hall.
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Если согласен, можем провести сделку снаружи Зала охраны.
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: Deal?
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Договорились?
records.source_evidence: User Jimmy screenshot dc7cf530 and local NPC-only log through04:53:45, 2026-10-13

records.speaker: Jimmy
records.source: [NPC] Jimmy: Great, we're now besties!
records.translation: [NPC] Jimmy: Отлично, теперь мы лучшие друзья!
